title: web-fetching-with-pullmd plugin configuration
description: Configures the PullMD instance and the WebFetch redirect hook. Place at ~/.claude/pullmd.json (user level) and/or <project>/.claude/pullmd.json (project level). Project values override user values per key.

instance.description: Base URL of the PullMD service, e.g. https://pullmd.example.com (no trailing slash). When absent at every level, the WebFetch hook is a no-op.

enabled.description: Master switch for the WebFetch redirect hook. Set false to disable redirection without removing the config.

mcp_tool.description: Name of the PullMD MCP tool to recommend in the deny message. Override if your MCP server is registered under a different name (e.g. mcp__plugin_<plugin>_<server>__read_url).

escape_after.description: Allow the Nth WebFetch attempt of the same URL through. With the default 2, the first attempt is blocked and a retry is allowed — the escape hatch for JSON APIs or URLs PullMD cannot handle.

allow_hosts.description: Extra hosts always allowed through WebFetch (in addition to the configured instance host and GitHub). Matches the exact host or any subdomain of it.

debug.description: Log allow/deny decisions to stderr with a [pullmd] prefix.
